name: Delta Lake to Lakehouse CDC Flex Template
description: Reads Change Data Feed (CDC) records from a Delta Lake table on Google Cloud Storage and applies row-level changes (INSERT, UPDATE_BEFORE, UPDATE_AFTER, DELETE) to a GCP Lakehouse (Apache Iceberg) table.

parameters.name: deltaTable
parameters.label: Source Delta Lake Table GCS Path
parameters.helpText: GCS path of the source Delta Lake table repository to read CDC data from (e.g., gs://my-delta-lake-bucket/delta_lake/employee_data/).

parameters.name: lakehouseTable
parameters.label: Target GCP Lakehouse Table
parameters.helpText: Target GCP Lakehouse Iceberg table identifier: '<project>.<warehouse_bucket>.<namespace>.<table>', '<warehouse_bucket>.<namespace>.<table>', or '<namespace>.<table>'.

parameters.name: startVersion
parameters.label: Start Delta Commit Version (Inclusive)
parameters.helpText: Starting Delta Lake commit version (inclusive) to read changes from. Either startVersion or startTimestamp must be provided.

parameters.name: endVersion
parameters.label: End Delta Commit Version (Inclusive)
parameters.helpText: Ending Delta Lake commit version (inclusive) to read changes up to.

parameters.name: startTimestamp
parameters.label: Start Timestamp (ISO-8601)
parameters.helpText: Starting timestamp in ISO-8601 format (e.g., '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z') to read Delta Lake changes from.

parameters.name: endTimestamp
parameters.label: End Timestamp (ISO-8601)
parameters.helpText: Ending timestamp in ISO-8601 format (e.g., '2026-10-01T23:59:59Z') to read Delta Lake changes up to.

parameters.name: warehouse
parameters.label: Lakehouse Warehouse GCS URI
parameters.helpText: GCS warehouse location for the GCP Lakehouse catalog (e.g., 'gs://my-lakehouse-warehouse-bucket'). Optional when lakehouseTable includes the warehouse bucket.

parameters.name: equalityColumns
parameters.label: Primary Key / Equality Columns
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated list of primary-key (equality-delete) column names in the target Lakehouse Iceberg table (e.g., 'employee_id').

parameters.name: upsert
parameters.label: Enable Upsert Mode
parameters.helpText: If true, drops UPDATE_BEFORE records and applies INSERT/UPDATE_AFTER records as upserts. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: usePortableRunner
parameters.label: Use Dataflow Portable Runner (Runner v2)
parameters.helpText: If true (default), runs on Dataflow Portable Runner (use_runner_v2) with _change_type column mapping.

parameters.name: catalogName
parameters.label: Iceberg Catalog Name
parameters.helpText: Name of the Iceberg catalog instance. Defaults to 'lakehouse'.

parameters.name: catalogUri
parameters.label: Lakehouse REST Catalog URI
parameters.helpText: Lakehouse Iceberg REST Catalog endpoint URI. Defaults to https://biglake.googleapis.com/iceberg/v1/restcatalog.

parameters.name: sinkId
parameters.label: Iceberg CDC Sink ID
parameters.helpText: Optional stable identifier for the Iceberg CDC sink ('sink_id') used for idempotency tokens in snapshot summaries (e.g., '<dag_id>-v2-to-v4'). Retries reusing the same sinkId skip already-committed ranges.

parameters.name: waitUntilFinish
parameters.label: Wait Until Finish
parameters.helpText: If true, waits until the pipeline completes. When launched as a Dataflow Flex Template, the pipeline automatically exits after submitting the job graph.
